notablePrerequisites: You have an amount of mana available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Skyfire Phoenix trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
